text:
Maria Chen: Quick evening provisioning pulse — short standup.

Maria Chen: What I did: spun up +4 g4dn nodes in eu-west3 and rebalanced jobs off legacy-pool-2.

Maria Chen: Blockers: 2 instances stuck in 'Initializing' (image pull fail). Can't finish autoscaler test. Logs show `ERR_IMAGE_PULL`.

Maria Chen: Today: coordinating with cloud infra to replace the image, will retry drain+recreate after image fix. Pinging @Kevin for quota bump if needed.

Kevin Patel: On it — raised quota request with cloud support, ticket #CLD-1129 (https://cloud.example/ticket/CLD-1129). ETA ~4h. I also restarted the node agent on the two stuck instances.

Tony Nguyen: FYI I saw increased pod churn earlier — might be preemption. Can we force-split workloads to a lower-priority pool? If yes I'll submit a PR to the admission controller.

Sarah Lopez: For drain/recreate, use this sequence:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-45
kubectl drain gpu-node-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
gcloud compute instances reset gpu-node-45
```

Sarah Lopez: Also checking GPU metrics: `sum(gpu_free{pool="eu-west3"}) by (instance_type)` shows about 6 free GPUs right now — headroom ~1.5 nodes.

infra-bot: autoscaler: detected scale-up failure on pool 'eu-west3-gpu', reason=image-pull-error, action=notified-team

Maria Chen: Thanks @Sarah and @Kevin. If quota comes through I'll do a canary scale to +2 then monitor latency.

Tony Nguyen: If you want me to open the admission controller PR I can target it for tomorrow morning.

Kevin Patel: Quota update: cloud support asked for justification doc; I've uploaded one to /docs/quota-requests/CLD-1129.md and cc'ed @Elena from Cloud Eng.

Elena Ramos: I can join the call in 30m to help with the justification if needed. Also, quick ask — anyone seen spikes from inference-test harness?

Maria Chen: Not since 16:00 UTC. I ran a quick harness-run: 2000 reqs over 10m, p95 latency 210ms (within SLO).

Sarah Lopez: I'll post a short grafana panel link in the thread in a bit. :eyes:

Maria Chen: Ok wrapping — will update thread after image replacement and after Kevin's quota reply. Thanks all :pray:
